notice: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. Teams, players, games and every number shown are invented by a simulator to exercise the pipeline and the app. Nothing here is an NBA result.

heads.label: Who finishes the possession
heads.baseline: Usage shares among the five on the floor, from games before tip-off, shrunk toward one in five

heads.label: How the possession ends
heads.baseline: The offense's ending shares from games before tip-off, shrunk toward the league's

heads.label: Where the shot comes from
heads.conditional_on: the possession ends in a shot
heads.baseline: The offense's shot mix from games before tip-off, shrunk toward the league's

heads.label: What kind of shot it is
class_labels: Layup or dunk, no move noted
heads.conditional_on: the possession ends in a shot
heads.baseline: The style mix of the five on the floor (each player's own from games before tip-off, weighted by usage), shifted by how the league's mix changes with the way the possession started

heads.label: How early the first action comes
heads.conditional_on: the period had at least 24 seconds left when the possession started
heads.baseline: The offense's early, middle and late shares on possessions that started the same way, from games before tip-off, shrunk toward the league's

heads.label: Timeout at a stoppage
heads.conditional_on: play has stopped in regulation, no mandatory timeout is due, and the team has a timeout left (after a made basket or free throw, only the team scored on)
heads.baseline: The league's rate in earlier games for that kind of stoppage, part of the game, and opponent's unanswered points (0 to 3, 4 to 6, 7 or more)

heads.label: A player sits after a foul
heads.conditional_on: a player on the floor commits his first to fifth personal foul; taken out means before the clock runs again
heads.baseline: The league's rate in earlier games for that foul number in that period

heads.label: Who closes a close game
heads.conditional_on: the game is within 5 points with five minutes left in the fourth quarter; predicted as the third quarter ends, for each player who has played; closing means being one of the team's five with the most of those minutes
heads.baseline: How often the player has closed for this team in earlier close games, pulled toward the league's rate for starters or for bench players

splits.rule: By game and by season, never by possession. Last season held out whole; latest 20% of earlier games held out; models train on the rest (latest 15% of it only picks the tree count).

tendency_method.label: Partial pooling across teams, situations and players (empirical Bayes, hierarchical logit)
tendency_method.note: Deviations are estimated on the logit scale with partial pooling: a team's rate against the league, its rate in a situation against its other possessions, a player's share against what his usage and the four teammates on the floor predict. Intervals include the baseline's own uncertainty and how much tendencies moved between the halves of an earlier season. Rows are ranked by the probability that the deviation is larger than one percentage point. Checked by fitting on the first half of a season and predicting the second; the table is on the scorecard.

labels.label: What kind of shot ended it
labels.source: Shot descriptor and subType, mapped to ten styles
labels.defined_when: the possession ends in a shot that is not an end-of-period heave

labels.label: Assisted or not, and by whom
labels.source: The assist credited on the basket
labels.defined_when: the possession ends in a made basket; the feed credits no assist on a miss

labels.label: Seconds to the first shot, turnover or trip to the line
labels.source: Period clock at the start and at that first action

labels.label: Early (within 8 s), middle or late (16 s or more)
labels.source: The same clocks; the feed has no shot clock
labels.defined_when: the period had at least 24 seconds left when the possession started

labels.label: Fast break
labels.source: The scorer's tag on the shot or its free throws, added after the fact
labels.defined_when: the possession ends in a shot or at the line; turnovers carry no tag
labels.note: Two tags from the same scorer can be checked against this pipeline: second-chance agrees with its offensive-rebound count on 100.0% of 22,964 tagged possessions, and from-turnover with how the possession started on 100.0%.

labels.label: Two-for-one taken or passed up
labels.defined_when: the possession starts with 30 to 45 seconds left in the period; taken means the first action came with 27 or more left

not_modelled.label: Late deliberate fouls
not_modelled.why: The scorer's "take" word marks them cleanly (33 of 33 here came in the last minute of the fourth quarter or overtime), but it is one narrow situation that the score and the clock nearly decide, and the step allows three heads.

not_modelled.label: Challenges
not_modelled.why: The feed logs a challenge as a timeout and nothing else: not which call was challenged and not whether it succeeded. There are 0.76 a game here, too few to model without knowing what was at stake.

not_modelled.label: The next substitution in general
not_modelled.why: Who comes in for whom is a choice among every pairing on the roster. The foul-trouble head is the one slice of it with a yes-or-no label at a single whistle.
